title: UltraTech Cement hires Loesche for two clinker and slag grinding plants
summary: UltraTech hires Loesche for two clinker and slag grinding plants
body_markdown:
**India:** Loesche announced on 13 November 2026 that it had won contracts to supply clinker and slag grinding plants for UltraTech Cement’s Wanakbori plant in Gujarat and Dankuni plant in West Bengal. The Wanakbori plant will feature a vertical roller mill with a capacity of 180t/hr for slag grinding and more than 400t/hr for less finely ground products, while the Dankuni mill will have a capacity of 120t/hr for ordinary Portland cement (OPC).


Commissioning of both plants is scheduled for the first quarter of 2027.
